item.title: Lay's: Lay’s New Potato Chips Are Cashing In On A Very Old Trend
item.description: Chocolate-covered potato chips are making a comeback, and Lay’s is giving the sweet-and-salty snack another shot just in time for the holidays. The brand is bringing back its chocolate-covered Wavy chips, but this time there are two versions for snackers to choose from: Wavy Milk Chocolate Covered Potato Chips and the new Wavy Dubai-Style Dark Chocolate… (Via Sporked)

item.title: Here's What To Order From McDonald's To Make Breakfast Tacos
item.description: McDonald's may not offer breakfast tacos on its menu, but that hasn't stopped fans from DIY-ing this sweet and savory morning meal. Here's how to order it! (Via Mashed (Fast Food & Grocery))

item.title: These 7 Dollar Tree Finds Are Perfect Stocking Stuffers
item.description: There’s a lot to talk about when it comes to finding stocking stuffers at Dollar Tree! I couldn’t whittle this list down any further because I’m just so dang excited about what’s in store. These are the perfect things to grab because they’re all available for only $1.25. That means you’re going to be saving a lot while not skimping on the gifts. (Via Sporked)

item.title: One Of Aldi's Best Breakfast Finds Of 2026 Rivals Eggo And Has 4X More Protein
item.description: If you're hoping to hit your protein goals and appease your sweet tooth, then you might want to check out a hearty and drool-worthy Eggo dupe from Aldi. (Via Tasting Table)

item.title: Popeyes Just Dropped An Apple Pie Inspired Dessert
item.description: Popeyes has a new dessert for anyone who loves the combination of warm apples, cinnamon, and a crunchy topping. The fast-food chain has added an Apple Crisp Cup to its menu, featuring baked cinnamon apple filling topped with a sweet and crispy oat topping. (Via Sporked)

item.title: Momofuku’s Famous Barrel Aged Soy Sauce Is Back For The Very Last Time
item.description: Momofuku is bringing back its Barrel Aged Soy Sauce for one final release, giving fans one last chance to grab a bottle before it disappears for good. And with only 5,000 bottles available, this could be one Black Friday food find worth paying attention to. (Via Sporked)

item.title: The One Menu Item All Taco Bell Employees Hate
item.description: I love that we get a view into the mind of restaurant employees through Reddit. It’s like our own personal version of Kitchen Confidential into every restaurant imaginable. Today’s inside scoop comes from the Taco Bell subreddit. There was a question asked about which menu item sucks the most to make and honestly the number one answer makes a ton of sense. (Via Sporked)

item.title: This Holiday Limited-Edition Dessert Is Perfect For Peanut Butter Lovers
item.description: The holiday season is a great excuse to eat more chocolate, and peanut butter lovers now have another reason to get excited. Bauducco has teamed up with Skippy to give its popular Chocottone a delicious makeover and the new creation sounds like something chocolate and peanut butter fans will want to try. (Via Sporked)

item.description: My problem with hot chocolate is that I’m far too impatient to drink it. I’ll take a sip almost immediately after making it, burn my tongue, and spend the next ten minutes blowing on it before getting distracted and letting the whole thing go cold. (Via Sporked)
